payload.title: Senior Account Executive - SMB SaaS
payload.description:
Senior Account Executive - SMB SaaS 
Remote | Full-Time | Base: $70| OTE of $115K + Uncapped Commission   

Join a mission-driven team that's transforming global compliance.  

Registrar Corp’s mission is to promote consumer health and safety by providing over 32,000 food, cosmetic, medical device, and drug clients in 180 countries with compliance software and services. We're a fast growing team spanning 21 offices worldwide and always looking for talented and dedicated professionals to join us. 

Registrar Corp is seeking a driven Senior Account Executive to join our growing SMB SaaS Sales Team. In this role, you’ll help expand adoption of our fast-growing ComplyHub software—an essential compliance solution for food and beverage companies including retailers, CPG brands, and manufacturers. With 60% year-over-year growth, ComplyHub is transforming how regulatory and purchasing teams manage food safety. You’ll own the full sales cycle—from prospecting and demos to negotiation and close—in a fast-paced environment with a quick sales cycle.  

If you're passionate about food safety, tech, and making an impact, we’d love to hear from you!   

Role Responsibilities:     

  • Manage the full sales cycle from prospecting and lead qualification to product demos, negotiation, and closing 

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with new and existing clients to drive ongoing sales opportunities 

  • Identify key decision-makers, schedule meetings, and deliver consultative sales presentations and demos tailored to client needs 

  • Consistently meet or exceed monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets   

Required Skillet and Experience:     

  • Experience & Performance: 2–5 years of success as an Account Executive in SMB software sales. Demonstrated track record of quota attainment and excellence in vertical-specific roles. 

  • Sales Acumen: Proven ability to source, identify, and develop new business opportunities. Experienced in outbound calling and consistently exceeding sales quotas. 

  • Consultative Selling: Adept at uncovering client needs and delivering tailored solutions within vertical-specific sales environments. Strong preference for experience using MEDDICC or similar frameworks to drive complex deal cycles. 

  • Results-Driven Mindset: Energetic and motivated with a positive attitude. Skilled at managing multiple client relationships in fast-paced settings with short sales cycle while delivering measurable results.  

  • Technical Proficiency: Experienced in leveraging CRM systems and sales tools—including Microsoft Office, Vonage, and HubSpot—to streamline workflows and enhance productivity. 

  • Adaptability: Thrives in dynamic, evolving sales environments with a strong willingness to learn and grow  

Preferred Qualifications:   

  • Background in selling regulatory or compliance solutions, particularly within the food & beverage or life sciences sectors. 

  • Familiarity with food and beverage industry regulations, particularly FSVP (Foreign Supplier Verification Program) compliance 

  • Foreign language proficiency, especially Spanish, is a strong plus 

  • Bachelors or Masters Degree 

Why Registrar Corp?

  • Remote work eligibility in select U.S. states  

  • Comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, mental health support, 401(k) with company match, paid time off, and professional development funds 

  • Supportive, collaborative team culture with opportunities for growth 

  • Target salary range of 70k base OTE $115 + uncapped commission    

Registrar Corp is a global compliance and training company established in 2003.  Registrar Corp is not a government agency. Registrar Corp is not affiliated with the U.S. FDA.  

#LI-REMOTE #LI-MO1

payload.title: Enterprise SaaS Account Executive – US Food & Multi-Solution Sales
payload.description:
Enterprise SaaS Account Executive – US Food & Multi-Solution Sales

Remote | Full-Time | Base Salary: $120,000 | OTE: $240,000 (Uncapped Commission)

Join a mission-driven team that's transforming global compliance to promote consumer health and safety by providing over 30,000+ food, cosmetic, medical device, and drug companies in 190+ countries with compliance software and services. We are growing fast and seeking a high-performing Enterprise Account Executive to join our team. 

We are looking for a driven, strategic, and results-oriented Enterprise SaaS Account Executive to join our growing US Sales organization.

Position Summary: 

This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced enterprise sales professional who thrives on developing new business, building relationships with executive decision-makers, and selling a broad portfolio of software and technology-enabled services.

While the primary focus will be on enterprise customers within the Food & Beverage industry, this role requires the ability to identify, position, and sell multiple Registrar Corp solutions across different product offerings and lines of business.

Our flagship compliance platform, ComplyHub, has experienced 60% year-over-year growth and is transforming how regulatory, quality, and procurement teams manage food safety and supplier compliance.

The ideal candidate is a proven new-logo hunter who can navigate complex enterprise sales cycles, uncover customer challenges, and position the right combination of SaaS, compliance technology, and professional services to deliver meaningful business outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

Enterprise Sales & New Business Development

  • Own the complete enterprise sales cycle, from strategic prospecting and initial discovery through product demonstrations, proposal development, negotiation, and close.
  • Develop and execute a comprehensive territory and account strategy focused on acquiring new enterprise customers and consistently exceeding revenue targets.
  • Build and maintain a robust pipeline through proactive outbound prospecting, account-based selling, industry networking, referral partnerships, and targeted campaigns.
  • Engage senior executives and key stakeholders across regulatory affairs, quality assurance, procurement, operations, IT, and executive leadership.
  • Identify high-value opportunities within retailers, CPG brands, manufacturers, distributors, and other enterprise organizations.
  • Develop multithreaded relationships within target accounts to navigate complex purchasing processes and accelerate sales cycles.

Multi-Product & Solution Selling

  • Develop a strong understanding of Registrar Corp's portfolio of SaaS platforms, technology-enabled compliance solutions, regulatory services, and professional services.
  • Demonstrate the ability to sell multiple products and solutions across different lines of business, identifying opportunities where customers can benefit from a broader relationship with Registrar Corp.
  • Lead with customer business challenges rather than individual product features, positioning integrated solutions that address regulatory, operational, and technology needs.
  • Identify opportunities to bundle software and services to create greater customer value and increase overall deal size.
  • Collaborate with product specialists, regulatory experts, and other internal teams to design solutions tailored to complex enterprise requirements.
  • Stay informed about new product capabilities, regulatory developments, and emerging market opportunities to expand the solutions presented to prospective customers.
  • Identify opportunities for additional product adoption and coordinate with account management teams to support long-term customer growth.

Consultative Selling & Customer Engagement

  • Conduct comprehensive discovery to understand customer challenges, business objectives, regulatory obligations, and technology requirements.
  • Deliver compelling product demonstrations and executive-level presentations that clearly communicate business value and measurable outcomes.
  • Build relationships with enterprise decision-makers and position Registrar Corp as a trusted strategic partner.
  • Understand competitive alternatives and effectively differentiate Registrar Corp's solutions.
  • Work closely with Product and Marketing teams to share customer feedback, identify emerging needs, and influence future solution development.
  • Negotiate complex commercial agreements while maintaining a strong focus on customer value and profitable growth.

Pipeline Management & Sales Execution

  • Maintain a consistent and healthy pipeline sufficient to achieve assigned sales quotas.
  • Execute disciplined outbound prospecting activities to continuously generate new enterprise opportunities.
  • Develop strategic account plans that identify key stakeholders, business challenges, competitive positioning, and opportunities for multiple solution offerings.
  • Maintain accurate opportunity records, sales activities, and forecasts within the company's CRM platform.
  • Demonstrate strong sales process discipline, including qualification, opportunity management, deal progression, and forecasting accuracy.
  • Collaborate with Sales Development, Marketing, Product, Customer Success, and Sales Leadership to accelerate opportunities and improve conversion rates.
  • Consistently meet or exceed individual activity, pipeline-generation, new-logo acquisition, and revenue objectives.

Required Qualifications:

Enterprise SaaS Sales Experience

  • 5+ years of successful B2B enterprise SaaS or technology-enabled solutions sales experience, with a demonstrated record of achieving or exceeding quota.
  • Proven ability to independently source, develop, and close complex enterprise opportunities.
  • Experience managing multistakeholder sales cycles involving executive decision-makers and cross-functional buying committees.

Multi-Solution Selling Experience

  • Demonstrated ability to sell multiple software products, technology solutions, or professional services rather than relying on a single-product sales approach.
  • Experience identifying customer needs across different departments and positioning complementary products or integrated solutions.
  • Strong ability to communicate the value of both SaaS subscriptions and service-based offerings.

New Business Development

  • Strong prospecting and new-logo acquisition capabilities, including cold outreach, account-based prospecting, networking, and strategic pipeline development.
  • Experience using sales intelligence and prospecting tools such as LinkedIn Sales Navigator, HubSpot, Salesforce, Salesloft, or similar platforms.
  • Demonstrated ability to build and manage a self-generated pipeline.

Consultative & Strategic Selling

  • Strong discovery, business-value selling, negotiation, and closing skills.
  • Ability to translate complex software capabilities and regulatory requirements into clear business outcomes.
  • Experience developing relationships with VP-level and C-suite decision-makers.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.

Operational Excellence

  • Strong CRM discipline and accurate sales forecasting capabilities.
  • Ability to manage multiple complex opportunities while maintaining consistent prospecting activity.
  • Self-motivated, accountable, and comfortable working in a remote, performance-driven sales environment.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience selling into the Food & Beverage, CPG, retail, manufacturing, regulatory compliance, or life sciences industries.
  • Familiarity with FDA regulations, food safety, supplier compliance, quality management, and regulatory technology.
  • Experience selling software alongside professional services or managed services.
  • Experience selling enterprise platforms with multiple modules, products, or business applications.
  • Established relationships within the food manufacturing, retail, or CPG ecosystem.
  • Familiarity with structured enterprise sales methodologies.
  • Foreign language proficiency, particularly Spanish, is a plus.
  • Bachelor's degree preferred; equivalent relevant experience will be considered.

What Success Looks Like:

Successful Enterprise Account Executives at Registrar Corp consistently demonstrate:

  • New-Logo Acquisition: Proactively identifying, developing, and closing new enterprise customers.
  • Pipeline Generation: Building sufficient qualified pipeline through disciplined outbound prospecting and strategic account development.
  • Multi-Product Selling: Identifying opportunities to position multiple Registrar Corp software and service offerings within enterprise accounts.
  • Revenue Growth: Consistently achieving or exceeding individual revenue and bookings targets.
  • Sales Excellence: Maintaining accurate forecasts, strong opportunity management, and consistent execution throughout the sales cycle.
  • Customer Value: Building lasting executive relationships by helping customers solve meaningful business and regulatory challenges.

Compensation & Benefits:

  • Base Salary: $120,000 annually
  • Target On-Target Earnings (OTE): $240,000 annually
  • Commission: Uncapped, with opportunities for additional earnings based on performance
  • Remote work eligibility
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Mental health and wellness support
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Paid time off
  • Professional development opportunities
  • Collaborative, growth-oriented global team environment

Why Registrar Corp?

At Registrar Corp, you'll have the opportunity to sell solutions that address real business challenges and help organizations navigate complex global regulatory environments.

You'll represent an expanding portfolio of compliance technology and services, engage with enterprise customers across multiple industries, and contribute directly to the continued growth of our global business.

We are looking for sales professionals who take ownership of their territory, create opportunities through proactive prospecting, and are motivated by the opportunity to build meaningful customer relationships and exceed ambitious sales goals.

If you're an experienced enterprise sales professional who enjoys hunting new business, selling multiple solutions, and helping customers solve complex challenges, we'd love to hear from you.

Registrar Corp is a global compliance and training company established in 2003. Registrar Corp is not a government agency and is not affiliated with the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA).

payload.title: Inside Sales Representative
payload.description:
Inside Sales Representative  

REMOTE | Full-Time | Salary:22/hr OTE : 81k |Uncapped Sales Commission  

Join a mission-driven team that's transforming global compliance to promote consumer health and safety by providing over 30,000 food, cosmetic, medical device, and drug companies in 200 countries with compliance software and services. We are growing fast and seeking a high-performing Inside Sales Representative to join our team.   

Position Summary: 

The Inside Sales Tech-Enabled Services team plays a crucial role in educating both prospective and current international and US clients on U.S. Food and Drug Administration requirements for food, beverages, medical devices, drugs, and cosmetics. As an Inside Sales Representative within our team, you will be a pivotal regulatory resource, responsible for selling Registrar Corp’s solutions and services. In this role, you will manage the full sale cycle and actively engage with new businesses and clients through outbound calls while also managing inbound leads.   

If you are a motivated and ambitious individual with a passion for sales, regulatory compliance, and customer success, then we want to hear from you! Join the Inside Sales Tech-enabled Services team at Registrar Corp and embark on a rewarding journey in this impactful role where you will make a real difference real difference in ensuring compliance with FDA regulations but also contribute to our clients' success and safety.  

As a Inside Sales Representative, you play a crucial role in educating both prospective and current international and US clients on services Registrar Corp provides to help them comply with U.S. Food and Drug Administration requirements.   

If you are a motivated and ambitious individual with a passion for sales and client success, then we want to hear from you!   

Role Responsibilities:  

  • Develop and maintain a working knowledge of U.S. FDA requirements for food, beverages, medical devices, drugs, and cosmetics to best assist prospective and current clients.    

  • Manage the entire sales cycle, which includes identifying key decision makers and initiating new sales opportunities, securing meetings with prospects, delivering sales presentations, communicating value propositions, and negotiating contracts.   

  • Identifies market potential by qualifying business accounts.  

  • Experience in prospecting and lead generation.  

  • Expands international and US sales in existing accounts by introducing new products and services; developing new applications, finding customer solutions.  

  • Communicate cross culturally with business executives, managers, and supervisory-level contacts.    

  • Utilize interoffice communication software such as CRM, Microsoft Office, Vonage, etc.  

Required Qualifications: 

  • Sales Acumen: At least 1 - 3 years of experience in inside sales selling services or software. Ability to source, identify, and develop new sales; experience in conducting outbound calls to maximize sales opportunities and manage inbound leads. 

  • Consultative Focus: Experience nurturing opportunities from start to close; ability to diagnose prospect needs and build relationships through a consultative approach. Proven track record of making/exceeding sales quota 

  • Excellent Communication: Demonstrated proficiency in both verbal and written communication.  

  • Drive to Succeed: Positive attitude, high energy spirit, and the motivation to manage multiple clients simultaneously.   

  • Technical Proficiency: Ability to utilize software such as CRM, Microsoft Office, Vonage, Hubspot, etc.   

  • Flexibility: Ability to work 8.5-hour workdays between 7am-6pm. 

Why Join Registrar Corp? 

  • Remote-work eligibility in some US states 

  • Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k) with company match 

  • Paid time off and holiday pay   

  • Fast-paced, collaborative work environment  

  • Base compensation of $22/hour, OTE $81k; uncapped commission 

 

#LI-REMOTE
